notes.title: Patch 7.31.2025 System Adjustments
notes.content:
Interface Improvements
🗺️ Added minimap pinning functionality (lock position during navigation)
Progression Flow
↪️ Withdrawal Behavior Change:

Now returns to main menu after extraction

No longer auto-starts new run with current character
Research System
🔬 Sub-effect Sequence Restrictions:

Can no longer add multiple identical sub-effect clips

notes.content:

notes.title: Demo v0.5 Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107345/59df3b07f80eccc72d2732926b752a8d6dd6dd3f.png"]
Demo v0.5 Update Now Live!⚠️ Important Notice
Due to save file structure changes, if you played earlier demo versions:
In game → Settings → Game Saves → Delete Save
Prevents legacy save conflicts[hr][/hr]Update Details
Core Systems

✨ Removed all prebuilt cards (except Relic cards)

✨ Simplified card crafting:
• Removed trigger chance and value adjustment options
• Added "Consumption Type" and "Target Type" resource materials

♻️ Battle rewards now give crafting materials instead of prebuilt cards

⚙️ Refine now yields both material types

Character Progression

🔧 Replaced Operating Table stat system with:
• Heal HP | Bless Cards | Dismantle Cards

✨ Added "Ability" attribute (replaces "Luck" → "Technique")

🧬 New "Genetic Traits" system

🎭 Added 2 playable characters

Deck Building

🃏 Custom starter decks now via:
Genetic Traits → Card Effects + Character Templates

⚙️ All characters now have fixed base stats

Quality of Life

💾 Added auto-save:
Retains mission progress until completion/failure/extraction/restart

🗺️ Added regional environmental effects

🗺️ Revised minimap art

🗺️ Moved "Return to P.R.D.A." to world map

New Content

🌍 +1 new region

👥 +1 mystery event NPC

👾 +6 new monsters

🃏 +5 new Tarot cards

☣️ New card mechanic: "Plague Cards" (+7 cards)

🚶 Added roaming NPC (mimic player behavior)

Balance & Optimization

⚖️ Rebalanced buff mechanics

⚖️ Adjusted monster decks

🎲 Simplified Satan's Dice minigame

⚡ Optimized card effect execution code

Art & Presentation

🎬 Replaced final boss hand-drawn comics with cinematic scene
